scenes.vo: Trick one. cd dash takes you straight back to the folder you were just in.
Trick two. Forgot sudo? Type sudo, bang bang, and it reruns your last command with sudo.
Trick three. Press control R and start typing to search every command you have run.

caption:
3 terminal tricks you'll use every single day 👇

1️⃣ cd - → jump back to the previous folder
2️⃣ sudo !! → rerun your last command with sudo
3️⃣ Ctrl + R → search your whole command history
